## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: document requirements, teens behind the wheel and other BMV services
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The identity and lawful status lists overlap heavily; C teaches the rules that differ (hospital certificates, expiry, delayed birth certificates) rather than every listed document [A01].
The teen passenger statistic is printed without a source; it is taught only as the manual's statement [A04] (verify IN-DOCS-D-TEENPAX).
The registration renewal page is a service notice with phone, mail, kiosk and online channels and delivery times; it is isolated as dynamic [A06].
Real ID document rules point to REALID.IN.gov for the most current list, so the acceptable document lists are treated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 76 states that a teen's chance of a crash doubles with each passenger present, without citing a study; the claim is taught only as the manual's statement until an official source is matched.
